item.title: Small plane hits homes in Phoenix, crashes nose-down next to backyard pool, injuring 3
item.description: A small plane struck two homes in Phoenix on Wednesday before crashing nose-down in a backyard, injuring the two people on board and a man in one of the homes, authorities said.

item.title: War in Iran creates range of reactions in Philadelphia
item.description: Some Iranian Americans in the city say their loved ones back home support continued U.S. strikes.

item.title: Human skull, other skeletal remains found in South Jersey; investigation underway
item.description: Investigators responded and located additional skeletal remains, which they believe belong to an adult.

item.title: Philadelphia City Council's Housing Committee holds hearing on Safe Healthy Homes Act
item.description: A Philadelphia City Council committee heard some horrific stories on Wednesday from renters who are being forced to live in homes with bug infestations, leaks in the ceiling, and predatory landlords.

item.title: Quakertown residents continue calls for police chief's firing at borough council meeting
item.description: A tense borough council meeting drew renewed demands for the firing of Quakertown Police Chief Scott McElree and for felony charges against five students involved in a protest to be dismissed.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.

item.title: Owner says South Street bar unfairly targeted after anonymous, unfounded tips prompt police response
item.description: Video shows multiple officers entering the packed bar just after 11:30 p.m. Officers can be seen moving throughout the business, some using flashlights and heading to the upstairs.

item.title: AccuWeather: Steady rain to impact Thursday morning rush in the Philadelphia region
item.description: We have two rounds of rain to get through before improvements this weekend with milder temperatures.

item.title: New details released on leak in Chester County, Pa. creek
item.description: Officials say a "milky white substance" entered the waterway around 12:20 p.m. Saturday from a nearby industrial site. According to the DEP, the leak originated at Atmos Technologies.

item.title: Massive Logan Twp. explosion felt across Philadelphia region
item.description: The explosion rocked Savita Naturals, a commercial facility in Swedesboro that processes cocoa butter for the chocolate industry.
